items.text: Ravens QB Tyler Huntley suffered turf toe vs Bills, expected MRI; out for foreseeable future after replacing Lamar.
items.why: Turf toe injury in second quarter; MRI to determine timeline.
items.implication: Leaves undrafted Joe Fagnano as emergency option; Ravens may seek QB help short week.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson needs thumb surgery and will be placed on injured reserve after injury on first play vs Bills; coach says potentially season-ending.
items.why: Right thumb injury on first snap requiring surgery; IR minimum 4 games, potentially season over.
items.implication: Ravens QB chaos for ROS; earliest possible return Week 14 after bye.
items.opportunity: Backup situation volatile with Huntley also hurt; impacts Ravens pass-catchers volume/efficiency.

items.text: Breece Hall (quad) not expected to play and confirmed OUT/inactive vs Raiders per RapSheet update on ETR board.
items.why: Quad injury; cryptic reports and Q tag resolved to inactive.
items.opportunity: Braelon Allen expected to start and elevated to solid RB2.

items.text: Notable RB snaps: Broncos Jonah Coleman 41 (Harvey IR), Raiders Mike Washington 38 > Ashton Jeanty 25 (unclear if message/performance), Browns Sampson 39/Judkins 27 (Judkins 10 routes, TD bet), Steelers Warren 34 > Dowdle 28, Chargers Vidal 28/Mitchell 19/Hampton 18.
items.why: Post-game snap/route counts showing committee shifts and rolelegation risks.
items.implication: Jeanty/Hampton role concerns; Warren preferred; Judkins TD-dependent; Coleman surge with Harvey out.
items.opportunity: Warren free; monitor Jeanty/Hampton for rebound or continued split; Judkins goal-line.
items.conflict: Jeanty still productive on fewer snaps per some.

items.text: Sunday injuries watching: Lamar (thumb IR), Huntley (toe), Jeremiyah Love (ankle), Michael Wilson (ribs), plus Henry foot, Palmer hamstring, Ferguson ankle.
items.why: In-game or post injuries flagged for follow-up.
items.implication: Love/Wilson status for next week; Lamar already IR.

items.text: Actives: Colts RB Jonathan Taylor officially active; Cowboys WR George Pickens up; Titans WR Calvin Ridley up. Hall out.
items.implication: JT/Pickens full go despite prior Q/trade noise.
items.conflict: JT trade rumors still cloud projection.

items.text: Really tough projection on Jonathan Taylor amid trade rumors; expected to start but if trading him makes zero sense to play him; teams do insane stuff.
items.why: Trade rumors swirling; report says expected to start but uncertainty high.
items.implication: Volatile start/sit; monitor for actual usage or move.
items.conflict: Active and starting per reports but trade cloud.

items.text: With Breece Hall out, Braelon Allen rides again as a solid RB2.
items.why: Hall inactive opens full opportunity; Allen has college pedigree (186-1268-12 as true freshman).
items.implication: Start Allen as RB2 in fantasy.
items.opportunity: Lead back snaps/carries with Hall sidelined.

items.text: AJ Brown and TreVeyon Henderson listed OUT on weekend injury summary.
items.implication: NE pass game shifts; Henderson handcuff/backup opportunity elsewhere if applicable.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining NE WRs/TEs.

items.text: EXPECTED TO PLAY: Jadarian Price, Zach Charbonnet, George Pickens, Jaylen Waddle, Colston Loveland, Jakobi Meyers, Kenny Gainwell, Calvin Ridley, others. OUT: AJ Brown, TreVeyon Henderson, Kyle Monangai, Rashid Shaheed.
items.implication: Clears several for start consideration; confirms key outs.

items.text: Raiders: Mike Washington 38 snaps, Ashton Jeanty 25. Unclear if Jeanty out-carried 25-2 due to midweek comments, performance, or both.
items.implication: Role not fully secure; monitor for continued committee.
items.opportunity: Washington upside if Jeanty limited again.
items.conflict: Jeanty still had receiving production on limited snaps.

items.text: Saquon Barkley confirms Eagles informed him he is not going anywhere; no trade.
items.why: Org message relayed; Barkley comments confirm.
items.implication: Stability for PHI RB1 ROS; no handcuff panic.

items.text: Lamar Jackson obviously terrible (IR). But overall, lightest week of the year for injuries so far.
items.why: Despite Lamar, fewer major fantasy injuries than prior weeks.
items.implication: Fewer forced pivots league-wide this week.
